name: Stefan Kapičić
biography: Stefan Kapičić is a Serbian actor. He is son of actress Slobodanka Žugić. Recipient of an Award for Best Debutant, at 38th Nis Film Festival, Festival of Actors' Achievements in Fiction Films, 2003, for his first movie role in a feature "Almost Ordinary Story" by director Milos Petričić. He is a son of a ex-Yugoslavian basketball legend, World and European champion Dragan Kapičić.
